explanation: Of the 2 x 8 = 16 (clicked, not clicked) pairs, how many have the clicked article higher? 0.50 = random, 1 = perfect.
1 / position of each click, averaged: (1/2 + 1/7) / 2. Rewards a click near the top.
Quality of the top-10 order: clicks count more the higher they are (1 = both clicks at positions 1 and 2).
Share of the top 5 that was clicked: 1 click in 5 articles.
Share of the clicks found in the top 10: both clicks are there.
Is there at least one click in the top 10? Yes = 1, no = 0; averaged over lists it is a share.
